notes.title: Major Game Update for Last Line VR!
notes.notes:
Hi folks! Our lastest game update is live now!

Huge optimization improvements! Performance increased about %100

Clean and relax play sessions, many bugs fixed.

General game balance improved.

notes.title: New Update 1.1! Out now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/5e5f346dabd389c9190d43fd9a8dc38da37043fd.jpg

Hi everyone!
      In line with your comments and feedbacks about LL|VR, we have prepared a patch to make the game better. You can share your opinions and suggestions about the game from our discord channel and discussion section. In some comments the difficulty of the game was mentioned. We believe that the game is challenging, which increases the sense of survival. We like to challenge players with this approach that forces them to use the mechanics of the game.

New Features and Balance Settings of Game

New detailed tutorial map.
Zombie wave balance in story mode.
Turret and mine price balance
Decrease the percentage of deceleration when the character receives damage from the zombies.
Added '$' symbol to points.
Player HP is now x2.
In Home-Defense mode we add Tesla Turret and Mines.
Balanced maximum zombie size on Endless and Home-Defense modes.
New sound effects for buying gun or turrets.
Balanced Turret HP's
Balanced Magazine prices
And some minor additions

Bug Fixes

Sniper Rifle optics
Some issues of grab 2 weapon is fixed
Constant move speed fixed
Some weapon sizes was wrong
Vibration bug at last bullet
Colors of Boxes (enable/disable colors)
Fixed Pause Menu Buttons render range
Valve Index Run button click (can't test)
Player Height is lower than before
Lighting on Farm Night Map
Pause menu movement locked
And some minor bugs
Home-Defense Repair Buttons
Home-Defense Point saves


Discord: https://discord.gg/7trcr2r

Thank you for having us! Please let us know your opinions.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
LL|VR is available now! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/69fb80b4dc1303d8d7d1ee105231f7b516ce8941.png

   We would like to thank you all for your patience. Actually, we were planning on releasing the game during the Steam Summer Sales to offer a discounted price. But a couple of unexpected problems have delayed our process and we did our best to let you have the best experience. So,  to be able to make up for your patience, we would like to offer you a 20% discount for a week.

  You can always contact us through our web site or social media accounts on any subject including bug reports. We hope you enjoy the game and we are looking forward to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
LL|VR  will be released very soon!

The development is done but we are still making sure everything works as it is intented. Work harder get better! 

What you will get in this game? 

 

We have a cool game menu level which has a built-in tutorial map in it. Game has some unique controls so we have to tell you how to use it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/db72af8e458ab7fcb0f29c766e739d4852e7609c.jpg

 A short story line with 3 maps with several phases, some of which will take place during night time. But the night phases will be a bit scary.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/b000f82a859ec6a69a15411714b2cdda7c0d02f9.jpg

 Endless Game Mode: This game mode allows you to make some strategic choices. You will get more points with more zombie waves and more points mean more weapons, magazines, turrets and bombs. 

And yes, Endless Mode has unique maps. You will see much different places. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/5e5f346dabd389c9190d43fd9a8dc38da37043fd.jpg



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/4ab0a46ca107daa29248fc05da186fb83f6bac9e.jpg

Home-Defense Mode: In this mode, you're going to defense your house room by room and you will be able to barricade the passages.
 (Still developing-experimental. We are trying to finish it before release otherwise we will publish it with update.)

 

We are excited for the game's release day. We hope you will enjoy playing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1006900/Last_Line_VR_A_Zombie_Defense_Game/
